versos.texto_bv: O rei tomou os dois filhos que Rispa, filha de Aiá, havia dado a Saul — Armoni e Mefibosete — e os cinco filhos que Mical, filha de Saul, havia dado a Adriel, filho de Barzilai, o meolatita.
versos.traducao_literal: E tomou o rei os dois filhos de Rispa, filha de Aiá, que deu à luz para Saul: Armoni e Mefibosete; e os cinco filhos de Mical, filha de Saul, que deu à luz para Adriel, filho de Barzilai, o meolatita.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): O nome “Mical” no TM (מִיכַל) diverge da leitura מֵרַב (Merabe) atestada na LXX e na Peshitta, e seguida por NTLH, ARA e NVIPT. 2Sm 6:23 afirma que Mical não teve filhos, o que torna a menção aqui textualmente problemática. A BV segue o TM, mas a evidência externa favorece Merabe. — evidência: NTLH: “Merabe, filha de Saul”; ARA: “Merabe, filha de Saul”; NVIPT: “Merabe, filha de Saul”. 2Sm 6:23: “Mical…não teve filhos”. Crítica textual (BHS, BHQ) registra מרב como leitura preferida.

kjv.texto: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

vizinhos.7: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the Lord’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
vizinhos.9: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the Lord: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

web.texto: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

vizinhos.7: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
vizinhos.9: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the mountain before Yahweh, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.
